_doc: Per-model overrides for scripts/refresh/check_models.py. Keys match the 'model' field in data/v1/models.json. extra_urls are fetched IN ADDITION to the model's 'sources' and DO feed the change signature. news_query pulls Google News RSS for passive release/discontinuation signals — headlines land in news_headlines but NEVER feed the change signature (news churn would flag everything weekly). Pricing-aggregator URLs can be added per model under extra_urls at any time (public, no-key only). Entries are optional — models with no entry are checked using their models.json sources only. exclude_from_signature lists URL substrings that are fetched and recorded but excluded from change detection (verified-noisy rotating marketing pages).

defaults.user_agent: AI-Film-Guide-ModelWatch/1.0 (weekly freshness check; contact via repo)

DoP (Lite/Standard/Turbo).note: Watched since 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1) via Higgsfield's own help-center DoP guide: tier names, durations, and preset changes land there first. DoP has no public rate card; credit costs live in the app, so this watch tracks the model's shape, not its price.

Kling 2.5 Turbo.note: No source URLs; official Kling site. klingai.com excluded from the signature from 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1): its rotating homepage flagged all three Kling models in one run — verified-noisy. Still fetched and recorded every run.

Kling 3.0.note: klingai.com excluded from the signature from 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1): the homepage's rotating marketing copy moved once and flagged all three Kling models in a single run — verified-noisy, same treatment as hailuoai.video and lumalabs.ai. Still fetched and recorded every run.

Kling 4.0.note: klingai.com excluded from the signature from 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1): its rotating homepage flagged all three Kling models in one run — verified-noisy. Still fetched and recorded every run; GA signal comes from the remaining sources and the news feed.

Marketing Studio video.note: Watched since 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1) via Higgsfield's official API post (its rate table carries the Marketing Studio lines) and the platform pricing page. The record's per-clip credit costs are still third-party; a signature move here means Higgsfield republished rates or plans, not that the credit math is confirmed.

Seedance 2.5.note: No source URLs; official ByteDance/Seedance landing page.

Sora 2 / Pro / Max.note: Status discontinued per models.json. Watch sources for resurrection/rebrand; flag any change for review.

Soul 2.0.note: Higgsfield landing page is marketing copy; signals are noisy. Treat changed=true as 'page changed', not 'model changed'.

Soul Cast.note: No source URLs in models.json; checked via Higgsfield homepage extra_url.

Wan 2.6.note: No source URLs; official Wan (Alibaba) site.

Vidu Q4 Preview.note: Wave 30 (2026-10-11) correction: $0.014/s was the launch-headline promotional off-peak floor, not the list rate. Official rate card: $0.045/s at 540p, $0.12/s at 1080p, $0.39/s at 4K; I2V/ref-to-video 30% off through Nov 30. Watch for the final rate card. Pricing page added 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1); the API platform landing is fetched for reachability but excluded from the signature (app chrome, not a rate card).

FLUX 3 Video.note: Added wave 21 (2026-10-11). Watch for native 2K/4K and open-weights delivery. Pricing page added 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1): BFL publishes per-second rates there, so the pricing table now has a primary source to diff against.

Gemini Omni.news_query: Gemini Omni Google AI video model
Gemini Omni.note: Watched since 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1). The Gemini API pricing page is the primary source: Omni Flash is token-billed, so a rate move shows there before any blog post. The DeepMind model page is fetched for reachability but excluded from the signature (marketing copy rotates).

LTX-2.5.note: Watched since 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1). ltx.io refuses non-browser HTTP clients (connection dropped on repeated probes), so the watch runs on Lightricks' official GitHub releases page instead: fetched and recorded every run, excluded from the signature because GitHub page chrome (relative dates, reaction counts) churns without a release. New-version signal comes from the news feed and the sources below until ltx.io accepts the checker.

Vidu S2.news_query: Vidu S2 Shengshu real-time AI video
Vidu S2.note: Watched since 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1) on Vidu's official pricing page; the API platform landing is fetched for reachability but excluded from the signature (app chrome, not a rate card). S2's per-clip pricing was never officially published, so this watch catches the day it is.

Mirage Tesseract.note: Watched since 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1) on the official Tesseract product page. Tesseract is a free local engine with no rate card; this watch tracks scope changes (export limits, account requirements, agent integrations), not price.

Runway Gen-4.5.note: Watched since 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1) on Runway's official pricing page: plan credit bundles and the Gen-4.5 credit rate are published there, so a signature move is worth a manual rate check. Runway shipped no new model in 2026; the watch also catches the day that changes.

vivago R1.note: Watched since 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1) on vivago's official pricing page. The R1 record opened with no published rate; this watch exists to catch the first one.

PixVerse V6.note: Watched since 2026-10-12 (Watchtower 2.1) on the official PixVerse API docs: the guide's V6 rates are gateway-reported, so the docs are where a first-party rate card would land. The marketing homepage is fetched for reachability but excluded from the signature (rotating hero copy).
